rationale: Modern scholarship remains genuinely divided on Alcibiades I. Schofield identifies it as one of the major extended authenticity problems, and recent reference literature continues to treat it as a principal surviving disputed dialogue. The evidence does not justify either secure acceptance or confident rejection, so B is the appropriate project grade.
